entries.description: Driver id in EAX: walks the {id, table} pairs from 0047e5d4 and returns the matching table, or the terminator's negative id. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterDriver_FindRoutineTable.

entries.name: RasterDriver_InstallRoutines
entries.description: Copies the 0047e5d0 dwords of RasterDriver_FindRoutineTable's table into the routine table at 0047e540, returning 1, or 0 when the id is unknown. Gfx_SelectRenderTarget calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterDriver_InstallRoutines.

entries.name: GLDisplay_FirstOpenNoOp
entries.description: Empty body (pushes and pops EDI, EBX, ESI). GLDisplay_Open calls it on the first open ever. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's GLDisplay_FirstOpenNoOp.

entries.name: GLDisplay_LastCloseNoOp
entries.description: Empty body (pushes and pops EDI, EBX, ESI). GLDisplay_Close calls it when the open count returns to 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's GLDisplay_LastCloseNoOp.

entries.name: RasterDriver_OpenDisplay
entries.description: (driverId, bitmapHeader, info): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterDriver_OpenDisplay: through the driver's own routine table, slots 8 (bitmapHeader) and 9 () must return 0, then slots 10 (), 11 (bitmapHeader, info) and 7 (info+0x24, info); returns 1, else 0. Ghidra's fastcall prototype is wrong; all three arguments are on the stack.

entries.name: RasterDriver_CloseDisplay
entries.description: (driverId, info): calls slot 12 of the driver's own routine table (RasterDriver_FindRoutineTable) with info. GLDisplay_Close passes display+4. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's RasterDriver_CloseDisplay.

entries.name: Gfx_CopyRenderContext
entries.description: (ctx): copies the context's first 0x81 dwords to 0047c16c and its dwords 0x81..0x8a to 0047c370..0047c394. Gfx_SelectRenderTarget installs the target's +0x40 context with it.

entries.name: Gfx_SetClipBlock
entries.description: Stores its argument at 0047c3a8, the clip block the drawing primitives (Gfx_PlotPixel, Gfx_FillPolygon and the rest) read. Gfx_SetCurrentContext passes the context's +4.

entries.name: ClipBlock_Init
entries.description: (block, width, height): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ClipBlock_Init: zeroes +0..+0x210, sets +0x214/+0x218 to width-1/height-1, zeroes +0x21c/+0x220, and points the pen +0x224 at 0047c398 and the fill brush +0x228 at 0047c3a0. GLDisplay_Open initialises a display's clip block with it.

entries.name: Gfx_PlotPixel
entries.description: Plots one pixel at an {x, y} pair. Every checkerboard dither in the shell is a double loop over this, which is what proves it is a plot rather than a line-to.

entries.name: Driver3_BlitClipped
entries.description: Slot 26 of raster driver 3's routine table, the blit Bitmap_BlitClipDispatch calls: (bitmap, point, clipRect, flags) clips the bitmap at point to clipRect {x0, y0, x1, y1} inclusive, or to the surface (0047c40a width, 0047c40e height) when clipRect is null, then copies it in one of four orientations by flags bits 0-1 (bit 0 flips vertically, bit 1 horizontally): opaque when the bitmap's byte +5 has bit 0x10, otherwise skipping colour 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Driver3_BlitClipped (004898a0).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00459d5c; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004898a0

entries.name: Driver3_SpanCopy
entries.description: Slot 22 of raster driver 3's routine table, Raster_SpanCopy's: (pixels, y, x0, x1) copies x1 - x0 + 1 bytes from pixels into row y at x0, through the surface's row-offset table (0047c3e6: base, then row offsets), dwords then bytes; nothing when x0 > x1. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Driver3_SpanCopy (0048a382).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045a686; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0048a382

entries.name: Driver3_SpanFill
entries.description: Slot 24 of raster driver 3's routine table, Raster_SpanFill's: (colour, y, x0, x1) fills x0..x1 of row y with the colour byte, dwords then bytes; nothing when x0 > x1. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Driver3_SpanFill (0048a4a7).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045a7ab; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0048a4a7

entries.name: Raster_SpanTexturedClipped
entries.description: Draws the span at x DAT_0047e6a8, length DAT_0047e864, through the visible-run list at DAT_0047e6a4 (DAT_0047e6a0 {x, length} pairs), calling Raster_SpanTextured for each overlapping run after advancing the destination and u/v past the hidden pixels. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SpanTexturedClipped.

entries.name: Raster_SpanTexturedShadedClipped
entries.description: Raster_SpanTexturedClipped for Raster_SpanTexturedShaded. TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA (mode 1) and TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB call it.

entries.name: Raster_SpanTexturedGouraudClipped
entries.description: Raster_SpanTexturedClipped for Raster_SpanTexturedGouraud, also advancing DAT_0047e8a4 by DAT_0047e8a8 per skipped pixel.

entries.name: Raster_DepthTestSpan
entries.description: The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_DepthTestSpan: tests and writes DAT_0047e850 dwords of the depth buffer from DAT_0047e844 (value DAT_0047e848, step DAT_0047e84c) and leaves the visible runs at 0047e6ac, count DAT_0047e6a0, pointer DAT_0047e6a4. Both textured rasterizers call it per row when maybe_g_DepthBufferEnabled is set.

entries.name: Raster_SpanTextured
entries.description: Mode 0 span routine of TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA: fetches the texel at a packed page<<16 | v<<8 | u index into the atlas at 00497f20 and stores it, stepping u and v. Two halves selected by DAT_0047e88c: zero stores every texel, non-zero skips palette index 0. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SpanTextured.

entries.name: Raster_SpanTexturedShaded
entries.description: Mode 1 span routine of TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA and the only one TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB uses: each texel through the ramp row _DAT_0047e890 + (DAT_0047e8a4 >> 16) * 0x100, fixed for the span. Unlike DBSIM's Raster_SpanTexturedShaded it has only an opaque half.

entries.name: Raster_SpanTexturedGouraud
entries.description: Mode 2 span routine of TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeA: the ramp row per pixel, DAT_0047e8a4 stepped by DAT_0047e8a8; opaque only. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SpanTexturedGouraud.

entries.name: Int64_AddInPlace
entries.description: (lo*, hi*, addLo, addHi): adds the 64-bit value {addHi:addLo} to the one held in the two dwords, carrying from the low half. TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB and 0045c6f8 step their 64-bit accumulators with it.

entries.name: Int64_SubInPlace
entries.description: (lo*, hi*, subLo, subHi): subtracts {subHi:subLo} from the 64-bit value held in the two dwords, borrowing from the low half. TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB calls it.

entries.name: Int64Pair_Q16Divide
entries.description: (out, in): out[0] = ({in[1]:in[0]} << 16) / in[4] and out[1] = ({in[3]:in[2]} << 16) / in[4] -- two 64-bit values divided by one int32 divisor, keeping 16 fraction bits. TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB calls it.

entries.name: Raster_ScaleRunStep
entries.description: (out, delta, length, shift): out[0..1] = (int32)(delta64[0] / length) sign-extended and shifted left by shift as a 64-bit value, out[2..3] the same for delta64[1], out[4] = ((int64)delta32[4] << shift) / length. TSTexture4Poly_RasterizeB calls it once per row with the row's u/z, v/z and 1/z differences, giving their step over one 2^shift-pixel run.

entries.name: Raster_ClipEdgeCrossX
entries.description: The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_ClipEdgeCrossX: the crossing of edge a-b with the line x, interpolated from the smaller-x end by the flags; 0 when an endpoint lies on the line. Raster_ClipPolygonX's crossing routine.

entries.name: Raster_ClipPolygonX
entries.description: (count, in, out, flags): one Sutherland-Hodgman pass of a ring of 7-dword vertices against x in [ctx+0x210, ctx+0x218] of the current context; crossings from 0045c1e0. Returns the output count. DBSIM's Raster_ClipPolygonX uses ctx+0x218 + 1 as the upper bound.

entries.name: Raster_ClipEdgeCrossY
entries.description: The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_ClipEdgeCrossY. Raster_ClipPolygonY's crossing routine.

entries.name: Raster_ClipPolygonY
entries.description: Raster_ClipPolygonX for y against [ctx+0x214, ctx+0x21c]; crossings from 0045c46c. Returns the output count.

entries.name: Raster_BuildEdgeTables
entries.description: The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_BuildEdgeTables: same flags and 10-dword row entries, right-edge table 0048e604, left-edge table 00493104, result block 00497c04. Its flag-2 shift is 12 (DBSIM 10), and it builds the quadratic u/w, v/w fit with the Point3I/Point2I helpers instead of inline.

entries.name: Gfx_GetCurrentContextCopy
entries.description: MOV EAX,[0048e184]; RET -- a second copy of Gfx_GetCurrentContext. The clip and edge stages of the textured rasterizers call it.

entries.name: Point3I_Add
entries.description: (a, b): adds b's three int32 components to a's in place (z, then x and y through Point2I_Add).

entries.name: Point3I_ShiftRight
entries.description: (p, n): arithmetic right shift of an int32 point's three components by n (z, then x and y through Point2I_ShiftRight).

entries.name: Point3I_DivideXYByZ
entries.description: (out, p): when p.z is non-zero, out = (FixedDivQ16(p.x, p.z), FixedDivQ16(p.y, p.z)); otherwise out is left unchanged.

entries.name: Point2I_ShiftLeft
entries.description: (p, n): shifts an int32 point's two components left by n.

entries.name: Point2I_ShiftRight
entries.description: (p, n): arithmetic right shift (SAR) of an int32 point's two components by n.

entries.name: ClipRegions_BuildScanlineSpans
entries.description: VSHELL's copy of DBSIM's ClipRegions_BuildScanlineSpans (0048b9a8): the same code compiled separately -- the bytes differ only in register allocation and instruction order, and the callees match (Mem_NewArray twice, _memcpy). Flattens a region list into a per-scanline span table and stores it at 0047e92c where the DBSIM copy stores ActiveScanlineClipSpans. tools/scripts/es2_xref.py finds no branch to and no stored pointer of 0045d43c in VSHELL.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 0045d43c; byte comparison with DBSIM 0048b9a8

entries.name: GLBase_Dtor
entries.description: GLBase destructor (vtable 0047e986, RTTI name 'GLBase', 4 bytes): restores the vtable and frees the object when flag & 1.

entries.name: GLPrimitive_Dtor
entries.description: GLPrimitive vtable 0047be84 slot +0x18 (prim, flags): when set, decrements *005ddec0, GLBase_Dtor(prim, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: Stream_ReadCopy4
entries.description: (stream, count, buffer): calls the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18); a copy of Stream_Read. 0045d698 reads 0x10000 bytes into 00497f20 through it.

entries.name: TSContext_Ctor
entries.description: TSContext constructor (vtable 0047e9e1, RTTI name 'TSContext', 0x16 bytes): constructs the point at +4 (maybe_Point3I_Ctor) and the object at +0x10 (maybe_Point3S_Ctor). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSContext_Ctor.

entries.name: TSContext_CtorWithFrame
entries.description: (this, position int32[3], orientation int16[3]): installs the TSContext vtable 0047e9e1, constructs and fills the point at +4 and the triple at +0x10. TSCamera_Ctor's base call.

entries.name: TSContext_Dtor
entries.description: TSContext vtable 0047e9e1 slot 0, its only slot (context, flags): decrements the live-object counter at *005ddec0, restores the vtable, then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. TSCamera_Dtor, TSOrthoCamera_Dtor and the light destructors end with it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSContext_Dtor (0048bbb8).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0045da24; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 0045da24 DBSIM 0048bbb8

entries.name: maybe_TSLight_SetIntensity
entries.description: TSLight vtable 00472188 slot +4, inherited by TSSunLight (light, value): stores value at +0x1a. ShellMap_Constructor calls it with 0x100 on the sun it builds, as DBSIM's Light_CreateMissionSun does, whose entry reads the value as the intensity; the read of +0x1a by the shade code is not traced (Open).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0045da4c and 00423f43; DBSIM Light_CreateMissionSun

entries.name: Light_TransformToModelSpace
entries.description: (light, transform): transforms the light's position (+4, int32) by the transform and rotates its direction (+0x10) into the model-space copies at +0x22 and +0x2e. Raster_SetModelTransform calls it per light. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_TransformToModelSpace.

entries.name: maybe_TSOmniLight_SetIntensity
entries.description: (light, value): stores value at +0x1a as maybe_TSLight_SetIntensity does, and also value * light+0x38 at +0x3c. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's maybe_TSOmniLight_SetIntensity (0048bc60), whose name it takes.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045dacc; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0048bc60

entries.name: TSCamera_CtorDefault
entries.description: TSCamera's argument-less constructor (vtable 0047e9d1, RTTI 'TSCamera'): TSContext_Ctor, then the TSCamera vtable. Identical after normalisation to DBSIM's TSCamera_Ctor (0048bc78); VSHELL's TSCamera_Ctor is the argument-taking one Map_Ctor uses. tools/scripts/es2_xref.py finds no rel32 branch to 0045dae4 and no stored pointer of it.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0045dae4; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 0045dae4 DBSIM 0048bc78; es2_xref.py

entries.name: TSCamera_Ctor
entries.description: TSCamera constructor (vtable 0047e9d1, RTTI name 'TSCamera', 0x22 bytes): (obj, a, b, c, p5, p6) runs 0045d9d0(obj, p5, p6), installs the vtable and stores a at +0x16, b at +0x1a and c at +0x1e. Map_Ctor calls it.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045db04; RTTI at vtable-0xc

entries.name: TSOrthoCamera_Ctor
entries.description: TSOrthoCamera constructor (vtable 0047e9c1, RTTI 'TSOrthoCamera', 0x26 bytes): (obj, a, b, c, d, position, orientation) TSCamera_Ctor(obj, a, b, c, position, orientation), its own vtable, and d at +0x22. tools/scripts/es2_xref.py finds no rel32 branch to 0045db40 and no stored pointer of it.

entries.name: TSBase_Dtor
entries.description: TSBase destructor: decrements the live-object counter at *005ddec0, restores vtable 0047f858 and frees the object with Mem_Delete when flag & 1. Constructors such as TSSolidPoly_Construct install 0047f834 then 0047f858 then their own vtable, the same chain as DBSIM's 004a6a08 then TSBase's 004a6a2c, and the body matches DBSIM's TSBase_Dtor. The derived destructors chain to it, 21 direct call sites.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile and disassembly at 0045db7c; vtable chain compared with DBSIM's TSBase_Dtor

entries.name: TSBase_Render
entries.description: TSBase vtable 0047f858 slot +0x1c, the render slot's default: does nothing. TSGroupItem, TSPartBase and the three AN sequence classes keep it; the polys, parts and shape instances override it (TSSolidPoly_Render, TSGroup_RenderPolys, TSBitmapPart_Render, TSShape_Render and the rest).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0045dba4; es2_naming.py vtables VSHELL

entries.name: Light_Register
entries.description: (light): appends it to the 10-slot active light list at 005d8058 (count 005d8054) and returns 1, or returns 0 when the list is full or already holds it. ShellMap_Constructor registers its light. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_Register.

entries.name: Light_ComputeShadeForFace
entries.description: (normal, centre): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_ComputeShadeForFace (0048bedc), call for call: a 0-255 shade accumulated over the active light list at 005d8058 (count 005d8054) -- type 0 adds its intensity, type 1 subtracts (intensity * ((dot - 0x400000) >> 1)) >> 22 when that is negative, type 2 adds a distance-attenuated term. TSTexture4Poly_Render, TSShadedPoly_Render, TSGouraudPoly_Render, TSAliasShadedPoly_Render and TSAliasGouraudPoly_Render call it, with the normal negated for a back face.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045dd40, compared with DBSIM 0048bedc

entries.name: Raster_InstallViewProjection
entries.description: (view): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_InstallViewProjection, call for call: perspective shift (005d7fd4), near plane (005d7fd8), orthographic divisor when the shift is 0 (005d7fdc), the render context's clip rect +0x210..+0x21c, the projection centre (005d7fe0) less the context's +0x220 pair, then the view's transform inverted and installed with Raster_SetViewTransform. ShellMap_Paint and ShellMap_InstallCamera call it.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045e03c, compared with DBSIM 0048c1d8

entries.name: Raster_SetViewTransform
entries.description: (viewTransform): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SetViewTransform: installs viewTransform (the identity at 005d7fa8 for null) at 005d7fa0, rebuilds g_ModelToView from the model transform (005d7fa4) and it (00465739), copies that to g_ViewToModel and inverts it (Transform_InvertRigid), and sets g_EyeInModelSpace to the view-space origin carried back through g_ViewToModel.

entries.name: Raster_SetModelTransform
entries.description: Installs a transform as the renderer's current model transform (null means the identity at 005d7fa8); the pointer goes to 005d7fa4. Builds model-to-view = Transform_Concat(model, [005d7fa0]) at 005d7f60, its inverse (Transform_InvertRigid) at 005d7f80, and the eye position in model space (the origin through that inverse) at 005d7fc8. When the byte at 005ddbb0 is set, also moves each light in the list at 005d8058 (count 005d8054) into model space with Light_TransformToModelSpace, using the inverse of the model transform. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SetModelTransform (0048c338), same code.

entries.name: Raster_ModelToView
entries.description: (point, out): Transform_ApplyToPoint by the current model-to-view transform at 005d7f60 (built by Raster_SetModelTransform). The first step of Map_Project.

entries.name: Raster_ProjectSize
entries.description: (size, depth): (size << 8) / 005d7fdc when the focal shift 005d7fd4 is 0, otherwise (size << shift) / depth -- Raster_Project's scale for one length. TSBitmapPart_Render sizes its sprite with it.

entries.name: Raster_Project
entries.description: (view, out): perspective divide of a view-space point with y as depth: out = ((x << s) / y, (z << s) / y), s the focal shift at 005d7fd4. With a shift of 0 it divides by the fixed value at 005d7fdc instead of y, a parallel projection. Returns out.

entries.name: Raster_ToScreen
entries.description: (projected, out): out.x = x + [005d7fe0], out.y = [005d7fe4] - y: offsets a projected point to the viewport centre with y flipped to screen-down.

entries.name: TSPoly_FrontBackVisibilityTest
entries.description: (normal, centre), both three-short points: with the focal shift 005d7fd4 at 0, rotates the normal into view space through g_ModelToView and returns 1 when its depth component is negative; otherwise returns dot(normal, g_EyeInModelSpace - centre). Seven call sites in the poly renderers (TSSolidPoly_Render, TSTexture4Poly_Render and five more), each treating a positive result as front-facing. The same code as DBSIM's TSPoly_FrontBackVisibilityTest (0048c620).

entries.name: Poly_ProjectShapeVertices
entries.description: Projects the current polygon's vertices (count 005d8890, index list at 005d889e + first 005d8892 * 2) into the screen-point list at 005ddaae and sets its count 005ddbae. With the perspective shift 005d7fd4 zero it transforms each not-yet-seen vertex by g_ModelToView (0045f8b9), projects it with a constant divisor (x << 8 / 005d7fdc + 005d7fe0, -z << 8 / 005d7fdc + 005d7fe4), caches the screen point at 005dbb6e and marks it 2 in the per-vertex state bytes at 005d88a6, and returns 0. Otherwise it returns 00462eb8's result, the perspective path, which divides by depth and marks a vertex nearer than 005d7fd8 as 1. TSSolidPoly_Render and TSTexture4Poly_Render call it; TSSolidPoly_Render runs Poly_ClipRingToNearPlane when it returns 1.

entries.name: Poly_ClipRingToNearPlane
entries.description: Rebuilds the screen-point list 005ddaae for a polygon with vertices nearer than 005d7fd8: walks its edges, copies the cached screen point of each vertex marked 2, and for an edge with one end marked 2 inserts the point where it crosses depth 005d7fd8 (interpolated x and negated z, passed through 0045f772 with 005d7fe0). Returns the new count 005ddbae.

entries.name: Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithUV
entries.description: The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithUV: clips the current face's ring (count 005d8890, indices from 005d889e + 005d8892 * 2) to the near plane with a per-vertex {u, v} pair carried along, and returns the new count 005ddbae. TSTexture4Poly_Render's g_TexturedPolyUseBitmapBrush branch calls it with the UV corners at 0048a190.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045ee2c, diffed against DBSIM 0048cfec

entries.name: PolyFill_FillThenOutline
entries.description: (backFacing): fills the screen polygon 005ddaae (count 005ddbae) with GL_GetGlobal7 through 0045f8e7 for a front face or 0045f8d2 for a back face. When the line colour 005d7ffc differs from the fill colour 005d8004 and the mode 005d8000 is not 5, it sets the fill colour to the line colour and the mode to 4 and fills again. Does nothing for an empty list.

entries.name: Raster_SaveState
entries.description: (slot): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_SaveState: g_ModelToView, the model and view transform pointers (005d7fa4, 005d7fa0), g_EyeInModelSpace and, when 005ddbb0 is set, a 0x16-byte model-space copy per registered light through Light_GetModelSpaceBlock, which reads the fixed list slot [005d8058] every pass as DBSIM's does. ShapeNode_ComposeToViewTransform and ShapeRender_BindNodeTransforms save into the slots at 004869d8.

entries.name: Raster_RestoreState
entries.description: (slot): the VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Raster_RestoreState: reinstates the model and view transform pointers (005d7fa4, 005d7fa0), g_ModelToView, a recomputed g_ViewToModel (Transform_InvertRigid), g_EyeInModelSpace and, when 005ddbb0 is set, each registered light's model-space copy from +0x34 through 0045f907, reading the fixed list slot [005d8058] every pass as DBSIM's does. ShapeNode_ComposeToViewTransform restores slot 0 (004869d8) with it.

entries.name: TSCamera_Dtor
entries.description: TSCamera vtable 0047e9d1 slot 0, its only slot (camera, flags): decrements *005ddec0, TSContext_Dtor(camera, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. Map_Dtor deletes the map's camera through it. Ghidra had no function here.

entries.name: Vec2_Subtract
entries.description: (a, b): a.x -= b.x, a.y -= b.y on int32 pairs. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Vec2_Subtract.

entries.name: Vec3_Subtract
entries.description: (a, b): subtracts b from a in place, z first and then x and y through Vec2_Subtract; returns a. Light_Register (0045dc30) and 0045dec4 call it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Vec3_Subtract (00492952).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045f6c8; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00492952

entries.name: Point3I_Magnitude
entries.description: Math_FastMagnitude3D of an int32 point's three components, through Math_FastMagnitude3D_Thunk. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Point3I_Magnitude; Light_ComputeShadeForFace takes a point light's distance with it.

entries.name: Math_FastMagnitude3D_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to Math_FastMagnitude3D(x, y, z). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Math_FastMagnitude3D_Thunk.

entries.name: DotProductVec3Int_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to DotProductVec3Int with the same arguments. Plane_ClassifyPoint calls it.

entries.name: GL_GetGlobal
entries.description: (index): returns the pointer at 0048e160 + index*4. Index 9 (0048e184) is the current drawing context (Gfx_GetCurrentContext); index 7 is GL_GetGlobal7.

entries.name: GL_GetGlobal7
entries.description: GL_GetGlobal(7), the object at 0048e17c. GLViewport_Ctor copies its default viewport from that object's +0x40; GLBitmap_Draw and Font_DrawGlyph pass it to their blits.

entries.name: Point2I_Set
entries.description: (p, x, y): stores two int32 components.

entries.name: GL_FillPolygonEitherWinding
entries.description: (gl, count, points): Gfx_FillPolygonEitherWinding(count, points), ignoring the first argument. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's GL_DrawPolygonEitherWinding (0048d8ae).

entries.name: Point2I_Add
entries.description: (a, b): adds b's two int32 components to a's in place. Poly_ClipRingToNearPlane adds the projection centre with it.

entries.name: Transform_ApplyToPoint_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to Transform_ApplyToPoint with the same arguments.

entries.name: LightFrame_GetDirection
entries.description: (frame): returns frame+0x10, the int16 direction triple. Light_TransformToModelSpace reads the world direction through it; 0045f839 calls it on the model frame (+0x1e).

entries.name: RotateVectorByMatrixQ14_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to RotateVectorByMatrixQ14 with the same arguments. Light_TransformToModelSpace rotates the light's direction through it.

entries.name: LightFrame_SetPosition
entries.description: (frame, pos): copies an int32 triple to frame+4..+0xc. A light carries its world frame at +0 and the model-space copy at +0x1e; Light_TransformToModelSpace writes the model position through it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's LightFrame_SetPosition (0048d915).

entries.name: LightFrame_SetDirection
entries.description: (frame, dir): copies an int16 triple to frame+0x10..+0x14. Light_TransformToModelSpace writes the model direction through it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's LightFrame_SetDirection (0048d933).

entries.name: Light_GetType
entries.description: Returns light+0x16, the light type. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_GetType.

entries.name: Light_GetIntensity
entries.description: Returns light+0x1a, the intensity. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_GetIntensity.

entries.name: Light_GetModelPosition
entries.description: (light): LightFrame_GetPosition(light + 0x1e), the model-space position at light+0x22. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_GetModelPosition.

entries.name: Light_GetRangeNumerator
entries.description: Returns light+0x38, the numerator of the point-light falloff. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_GetRangeNumerator.

entries.name: Light_GetFalloffOffset
entries.description: Returns light+0x34, the denominator offset of the point-light falloff. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_GetFalloffOffset.

entries.name: Light_GetModelDirection
entries.description: (light): LightFrame_GetDirection(light + 0x1e), the model-space direction at light+0x2e. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_GetModelDirection.

entries.name: DotProductVec3Short_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to DotProductVec3Short with the same arguments. Light_ComputeShadeForFace dots the face normal with a directional light through it.

entries.name: Point3I_SubPoint3S
entries.description: (p int[3], s short[3]): p.z -= s.z, then Point2I_SubPoint2S for x and y; returns p. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Point3I_SubPoint3S.

entries.name: View_GetNearPlane
entries.description: (view) -> the dword at view + 0x1e. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's View_GetNearPlane.

entries.name: View_GetOrthoDivisor
entries.description: (view) -> the dword at view + 0x22. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's View_GetOrthoDivisor.

entries.name: Point3I_Set
entries.description: (p, x, y, z): stores three int32 components and returns p.

entries.name: Transform_ApplyToShortPoint_Thunk
entries.description: One-line forwarder to Transform_ApplyToShortPoint with the same arguments. Poly_ProjectShapeVertices calls it.

entries.name: GL_FillPolygonReversed
entries.description: (gl, count, points): Gfx_FillPolygonReversed(count, points), ignoring the first argument. PolyFill_FillThenOutline calls it.

entries.name: GL_FillPolygon
entries.description: (gl, count, points): Gfx_FillPolygon(count, points), ignoring the first argument. PolyFill_FillThenOutline calls it.

entries.name: Light_GetModelSpaceBlock
entries.description: (light): returns light + 0x1e. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_GetModelSpaceBlock.

entries.name: Point2I_SubPoint2S
entries.description: (p int[2], s short[2]): p.x -= s.x, p.y -= s.y. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Point2I_SubPoint2S.

entries.name: TSOrthoCamera_Dtor
entries.description: TSOrthoCamera vtable 0047e9c1 slot 0 (camera, flags): decrements *005ddec0 twice (its own level and TSCamera's), TSContext_Dtor(camera, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. Ghidra had no function here.

entries.name: TSBase_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSBase vtable 0047f858 slot 0, the class-item tag getter's default: returns -1. Inherited by TSGroupItem, TSShapeInstance, ANShapeInstance, VectorTable and HeightGrid. Ghidra had no function here.
entries.source: VSHELL disassembly at 0045f9dc (83 C8 FF: or eax,-1); vtables 0047f858, 0047ee64, 0047f195, 0047f420, 0047f884, 00472470

entries.name: TSBase_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSBase vtable 0047f858 slot +4, the stream-size getter's default: returns 0.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0045f9e4; identical after normalisation to DBSIM 0048dbdc

entries.name: TSBase_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSBase vtable 0047f858 slot +8, the memory-size getter's default: returns 0.

entries.name: TSBase_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSBase vtable 0047f858 slot +0xc, the class item's read from a stream, default: does nothing.

entries.name: TSBase_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSBase vtable 0047f858 slot +0x10, the class item's write to a stream, default: does nothing.

entries.name: Light_ResetSystem
entries.description: Clears the ten light slots (005d8058) and their counters, Light_EnableModelSpaceTransform, numbers the 32 shorts at 005d8014, zeroes 0x5b30 bytes at 005d8080, registers g_TSObjectTypeRegistry with ClassItem_RegisterBucket, and installs the identity (Transform_Reset on 005d7fa8) as both 005d7fa0 and the model transform 005d7fa4. Display_Init calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_ResetSystem (0048dbfc).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0045fa04; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0048dbfc

entries.name: RectI_Ctor
entries.description: Constructs the two 8-byte corner points at +0 and +8 (Rtl_ReturnArg, a no-op) and returns the object. GLViewport_Ctor builds its rect at +0x210 with it.

entries.name: Light_EnableModelSpaceTransform
entries.description: Sets 005ddbb0, the gate Raster_SetModelTransform tests before moving the lights into model space. Light_ResetSystem calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Light_EnableModelSpaceTransform (0048dd64).

entries.name: TSNullObj_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x14000e 'TSNullObj': 4 bytes from the arena, the ClassItem, TSBase and TSNullObj vtables (0047eebc last), then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSNullObj_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSNullObj vtable 0047eebc slot 0: returns 0x14000e, TSNullObj_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSNullObj_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSNullObj slot +4: returns 0; the object stores nothing.

entries.name: TSNullObj_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSNullObj slot +8: returns 4, the vtable pointer alone.

entries.name: TSNullObj_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSNullObj slot +0xc: does nothing.

entries.name: TSNullObj_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSNullObj slot +0x10: does nothing.

entries.name: TSPoly_Construct
entries.description: The class-item load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140001 'TSPoly': (stream, mode) Arena_Alloc's 0xc bytes from the arena DAT_00481244, stamps the ClassItem, TSBase, TSGroupItem and TSPoly vtables in turn (0047f834, 0047f858, 0047ee64, 0047ee90), then calls the object's vtable +0xc read with (stream, mode) and returns the object.

entries.name: TSPoly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot 0: returns 0x140001, TSPoly_Construct's tag in g_TSObjectTypeRegistry.

entries.name: TSPoly_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot +4: returns 8, the four int16s TSPoly_ReadFromStream reads. TSSolidPoly_GetStreamSize adds to it.

entries.name: TSPoly_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot +8: returns 0xc, the object's size.

entries.name: TSPoly_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot +0xc (poly, stream): reads four int16s with Stream_ReadWord2 into +4 (the normal's point index), +6 (the centre's), +8 (the vertex count) and +0xa (the vertex list's start), the names TSPoly_DebugPrint prints them under. The derived polys' reads call it first. Matches DBSIM's 0048df20.

entries.name: TSPoly_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot +0x10 (poly, stream): writes the four int16s TSPoly_ReadFromStream reads, in the same order, with Stream_WriteWord2.

entries.name: TSPoly_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot +0x14 (poly, verbose, indent): VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, then when verbose, each on its own line indented by indent + 1, 'normal %4d center %4d' (+4, +6) and 'vertexCount %4d vertexList %4d' (+8, +0xa) to stdout.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_Construct
entries.description: The class-item load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140002 'TSSolidPoly': TSTexture4Poly_Construct's shape, 0xe bytes from the arena, stopping at g_TSSolidPolyVtable, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSSolidPoly vtable g_TSSolidPolyVtable slot 0: returns 0x140002, TSSolidPoly_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSSolidPoly slot +4: TSPoly_GetStreamSize + 2, for the colour int16. TSTexture4Poly, TSShadedPoly and the alias solid and shaded polys inherit it; TSGouraudPoly_GetStreamSize adds to it.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSSolidPoly slot +8: returns 0xe, the object's size, inherited by the same four classes as TSSolidPoly_GetStreamSize.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSSolidPoly slot +0xc (poly, stream): TSPoly_ReadFromStream, then the colour int16 into +0xc, the surface field the renders index g_ActiveSurfaceRecords with (see TSSolidPoly_Render). Inherited as TSSolidPoly_GetStreamSize is.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSSolidPoly slot +0x10 (poly, stream): TSPoly_WriteToStream, then the colour int16 +0xc.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSSolidPoly slot +0x14 (poly, verbose, indent): TSPoly_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'colors %d' with +0xc, indented by indent.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_Construct
entries.description: The class-item load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x14000f 'TSTexture4Poly': (stream, mode) Arena_Alloc's 0xe bytes from the arena DAT_00481244 and stamps the vtables of each level of its inheritance chain in turn, as each inlined constructor runs (ClassItem 0047f834, TSBase 0047f858, TSGroupItem 0047ee64, TSPoly 0047ee90, TSSolidPoly g_TSSolidPolyVtable, TSTexture4Poly g_TSTexture4PolyVtable), then calls the object's vtable +0xc read with (stream, mode) and returns it. See docs/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSTexture4Poly vtable g_TSTexture4PolyVtable slot 0: returns 0x14000f, TSTexture4Poly_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSShadedPoly_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140003, named 'TSShadePoly' in the table: TSSolidPoly_Construct's shape (0xe bytes from the arena), stamping TSShadedPoly's vtable 0047ede0 last, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSShadedPoly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSShadedPoly vtable 0047ede0 slot 0: returns 0x140003, TSShadedPoly_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140009 'TSGouraudPoly': 0x10 bytes from the arena, the vtable chain through TSSolidPoly to TSGouraudPoly's 0047edb4, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly vtable 0047edb4 slot 0: returns 0x140009, TSGouraudPoly_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly slot +4: TSSolidPoly_GetStreamSize + 2, for the normal-list int16. TSAliasGouraudPoly inherits it.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly slot +8: returns 0x10, the object's size. TSAliasGouraudPoly inherits it.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly slot +0xc (poly, stream): TSSolidPoly_ReadFromStream, then the normal list's start int16 into +0xe. TSAliasGouraudPoly inherits it.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly slot +0x10 (poly, stream): TSSolidPoly_WriteToStream, then the int16 +0xe.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly slot +0x14 (poly, verbose, indent): TSSolidPoly_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'normalList %d' with +0xe.

entries.name: TSAliasSolidPoly_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140010 'TSAliasSolidPoly': 0xe bytes from the arena, the vtable chain through TSSolidPoly to TSAliasSolidPoly's 0047ed88, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSAliasSolidPoly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSAliasSolidPoly vtable 0047ed88 slot 0: returns 0x140010, TSAliasSolidPoly_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSAliasShadedPoly_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140011 'TSAliasShadedPoly': 0xe bytes from the arena, the vtable chain through TSShadedPoly to TSAliasShadedPoly's 0047ed5c, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSAliasShadedPoly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSAliasShadedPoly vtable 0047ed5c slot 0: returns 0x140011, TSAliasShadedPoly_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSAliasGouraudPoly_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140012 'TSAliasGouraudPoly': 0x10 bytes from the arena, the vtable chain through TSGouraudPoly to TSAliasGouraudPoly's 0047ed30, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSAliasGouraudPoly_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSAliasGouraudPoly vtable 0047ed30 slot 0: returns 0x140012, TSAliasGouraudPoly_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSGroup_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140014 'TSGroup': 0x28 bytes from the arena DAT_00481244, TSGroup_Ctor, then the object's vtable +0xc read with (stream, mode).

entries.name: TSGroup_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSGroup slot 0: returns 0x140014, TSGroup_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSGroup_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSGroup slot +4: TSPartBase_GetStreamSize + 8 for the four counts + 2 per index (+0x20) + 6 per point (+0x22) + 4 per colour (+0x24), plus ClassItem_ItemTotalSize of each item (+0x26).

entries.name: TSGroup_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSGroup slot +8: 0x28 + 2 per index + 6 per point + 4 per colour + 4 per item, plus each item's GetMemorySize.

entries.name: TSGroup_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSGroup vtable 00471bf4 slot +0xc (group, stream): TSPartBase_ReadFromStream, then the index count +0x20, point count +0x22, colour count +0x24 and item count +0x26; arena arrays for the indexes (+0x10, words), the points (+0x14, 6-byte maybe_Point3S_Ctor elements), the colours (+0x18, dwords) and the items (+0x1c); reads the indexes, points and colours, then loads each item with VshellClassItem_LoadItem(stream, 0). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSGroup_ReadFromStream (0048e8e4). Names from TSGroup_DebugPrint's labels.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0046069c; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 0046069c DBSIM 0048e8e4

entries.name: TSGroup_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSGroup slot +0x10 (group, stream): TSPartBase_WriteToStream, the four counts, the indexes, points and colours, then each item with ClassItem_StoreItem(item, stream, 0).

entries.name: TSGroup_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSGroup slot +0x14 (group, verbose, indent): TSPartBase_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'indexCount %4d pointCount %4d' (+0x20, +0x22), 'colorCount %4d itemCount %4d' (+0x24, +0x26), every index, point and colour, and each item's own DebugPrint with verbose - 1.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x14000a 'TSBSPGroup': 0x2e bytes from the arena, TSBSPGroup_Ctor, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSBSPGroup slot 0: returns 0x14000a, TSBSPGroup_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSBSPGroup slot +4: TSGroup_GetStreamSize + 2 for the node count + 10 per node (+0x28).

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSBSPGroup slot +8: TSGroup's sum with base 0x2e and 10 per node.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSBSPGroup slot +0xc (group, stream): TSGroup_ReadFromStream, then the node count into +0x28 and that many 10-byte nodes into an arena array at +0x2a (the layout TSBSPGroup_RenderNode walks).

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSBSPGroup slot +0x10 (group, stream): TSGroup_WriteToStream, the node count and the nodes.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSBSPGroup slot +0x14 (group, verbose, indent): TSGroup_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'nodeCount %d' and for each node 'coeff %8d poly %d' and 'front %4d back %4d'. Its loop bound is the index count +0x20, not the node count +0x28 it has just printed.

entries.name: TSGroupItem_Dtor
entries.description: TSGroupItem vtable 0047ee64 slot +0x18 (item, flags): decrements *005ddec0, TSBase_Dtor(item, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. Ghidra had no function here.

entries.name: Stream_WriteDwords
entries.description: (stream, count, src): writes count * 4 bytes through the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14). GLFont_WriteToStream calls it.

entries.name: Stream_ReadDwords
entries.description: (stream, count, dst): reads count * 4 bytes through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Stream_ReadDwords (0048f2de). GLFont_ReadFromStream calls it.

entries.name: TSAliasGouraudPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TSAliasGouraudPoly vtable 0047ed30 slot +0x18 (poly, flags): decrements *005ddec0 five times, once per level from TSAliasGouraudPoly down to TSGroupItem, TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. Ghidra had no function here.

entries.name: TSAliasShadedPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TSAliasShadedPoly slot +0x18 (poly, flags): five counter decrements (TSAliasShadedPoly to TSGroupItem), TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSAliasSolidPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TSAliasSolidPoly slot +0x18 (poly, flags): four counter decrements, TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TSGouraudPoly slot +0x18 (poly, flags): four counter decrements, TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSShadedPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TSShadedPoly slot +0x18 (poly, flags): four counter decrements, TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_Dtor
entries.description: TSTexture4Poly slot +0x18 (poly, flags): four counter decrements (TSTexture4Poly to TSGroupItem), TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TSSolidPoly slot +0x18 (poly, flags): decrements *005ddec0 once per level from TSSolidPoly down to TSGroupItem (three), TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TSPoly vtable 0047ee90 slot +0x18 (poly, flags): decrements the live-object counter at *005ddec0 once for TSPoly and once for TSGroupItem, TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSNullObj_Dtor
entries.description: TSNullObj slot +0x18 (obj, flags): decrements *005ddec0, TSBase_Dtor(obj, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSPartBase_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140005, named 'TSBasePart' in the table: 0x10 bytes from the arena, the ClassItem, TSBase and TSPartBase vtables (0047f834, 0047f858, 0047f0f8), then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSPartBase_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSPartBase vtable 0047f0f8 slot 0: returns 0x140005, TSPartBase_Construct's tag (named 'TSBasePart' in g_TSObjectTypeRegistry).

entries.name: TSPartBase_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSPartBase slot +4: returns 0xc, the three int16s and the 6-byte centre TSPartBase_ReadFromStream reads. Every part's GetStreamSize builds on it.

entries.name: TSPartBase_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSPartBase slot +8: returns 0x10, the object's size.

entries.name: TSPartBase_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSPartBase vtable 0047f0f8 slot +0xc (part, stream): reads the transform +4, the id +6 and the radius +8 (Stream_ReadWord each), then the 6-byte centre into +0xa through the stream's read slot: the head every part chunk carries (TSBasePart in the format docs). The derived parts' reads call it first. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSPartBase_ReadFromStream (0048f894), identical up to the word reader's name.
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 0046161c; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 0046161c DBSIM 0048f894

entries.name: TSPartBase_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSPartBase slot +0x10 (part, stream): writes what TSPartBase_ReadFromStream reads, in the same order.

entries.name: TSPartBase_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSPartBase slot +0x14 (part, verbose, indent): VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, then when verbose 'transform %d' (+4), 'IDnumber %d' (+6), 'radius %d' (+8) and 'center (%d %d %d)' (+0xa..+0xe), each indented.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140013 'TSBitmapPart': 0x14 bytes from the arena, the vtable chain through TSPartBase to TSBitmapPart's 0047f160, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSBitmapPart slot +0x14 (part, verbose, indent): TSPartBase_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'bmp %4d' (+0x10) and 'x offset %4d y offset %4d' (the signed bytes +0x12, +0x13).

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSBitmapPart slot +0xc (part, stream): TSPartBase_ReadFromStream, the bitmap tag into +0x10 and the x and y offset bytes into +0x12 and +0x13 (Stream_ReadByteCopy).

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSBitmapPart slot +0x10 (part, stream): TSPartBase_WriteToStream, the bitmap tag and the two offset bytes.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSBitmapPart slot +8: returns 0x14, the object's size.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSBitmapPart vtable 0047f160 slot 0: returns 0x140013, TSBitmapPart_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSBitmapPart slot +4: TSPartBase_GetStreamSize + 4, the bitmap word and the two offset bytes.

entries.name: TSPartList_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140007 'TSPartList': 0x16 bytes from the arena, TSPartList_Ctor, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSPartList_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSPartList slot 0: returns 0x140007, TSPartList_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSPartList_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSPartList slot +4: TSPartBase_GetStreamSize + 2 for the child count, plus ClassItem_ItemTotalSize of each child; 0 as soon as a child reports 0.

entries.name: TSPartList_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSPartList slot +8: 0x16 + 4 per child pointer, plus each child's own GetMemorySize (vtable +8).

entries.name: TSPartList_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSPartList vtable 00471ab8 slot +0xc (list, stream): TSPartBase_ReadFromStream, then the child count into +0x10, an arena array of that many pointers at +0x12, and each child loaded with VshellClassItem_LoadItem(stream, 0). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSPartList_ReadFromStream (0048fd94).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00461b1c; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 00461b1c DBSIM 0048fd94

entries.name: TSPartList_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSPartList slot +0x10 (list, stream): TSPartBase_WriteToStream, the child count, then each child with ClassItem_StoreItem(child, stream, 0).

entries.name: TSPartList_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSPartList slot +0x14 (list, verbose, indent): TSPartBase_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'count %d' and each child's own DebugPrint with verbose - 1 and indent + 1.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x14000b 'TSCellAnimPart': 0x18 bytes from the arena, TSPartList_Ctor, TSCellAnimPart's vtable 0047f12c, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart vtable 0047f12c slot 0: returns 0x14000b, TSCellAnimPart_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart slot +4: TSPartList_GetStreamSize, plus 2 for the sequence word when non-zero.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart slot +8: 0x18 + 4 per child, plus each child's GetMemorySize.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart slot +0xc (part, stream): TSPartList_ReadFromStream, then the animation sequence index into +0x16.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart slot +0x10 (part, stream): TSPartList_WriteToStream, then +0x16.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart slot +0x14 (part, verbose, indent): TSPartList_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'animSequence %d' (+0x16).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x14000c 'TSDetailPart': 0x1a bytes from the arena, TSDetailPart_Ctor, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSDetailPart slot 0: returns 0x14000c, TSDetailPart_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSDetailPart slot +4: TSPartList_GetStreamSize, plus (when non-zero) 2 per child for its size threshold.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSDetailPart slot +8: 0x1a + 6 per child (pointer and threshold), plus each child's GetMemorySize.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSDetailPart slot +0xc (part, stream): TSPartList_ReadFromStream, then one int16 size threshold per child (count +0x10) into an arena array at +0x16 (Stream_ReadWordsCopy): the table TSDetailPart_Render walks.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSDetailPart slot +0x10 (part, stream): TSPartList_WriteToStream, then the thresholds.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSDetailPart slot +0x14 (part, verbose, indent): TSPartList_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'sizeList %d = %d' per child.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140015 'TSBSPPart': 0x20 bytes from the arena, TSBSPPart_Ctor, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSBSPPart slot 0: returns 0x140015, TSBSPPart_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSBSPPart slot +4: TSPartList_GetStreamSize, plus (when non-zero) 2 for the node count and 0x10 per node: the 14-byte node and its 2-byte transform id.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSBSPPart slot +8: 0x20 + 0x10 per node + 4 per child, plus each child's GetMemorySize.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSBSPPart slot +0xc (part, stream): TSPartList_ReadFromStream, the node count into +0x16, then +0x16 14-byte nodes into an arena array at +0x18 (Rtl_VectorNew with TSBSPPart_NodeCtor) and their int16 transform ids into +0x1c (Stream_ReadWordsCopy).

entries.name: TSBSPPart_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSBSPPart slot +0x10 (part, stream): TSPartList_WriteToStream, the node count, the nodes and the transform ids.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSBSPPart slot +0x14 (part, verbose, indent): TSPartList_DebugPrint, then when verbose 'nodeCount %d', each node's 'normal (%6d %6d %6d)', 'coeff %d' and 'front %4d back %4d', and the 'Transforms' list.

entries.name: Stream_WriteByteCopy
entries.description: (stream, value): writes the low byte of its value argument through the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14).

entries.name: Stream_ReadByteCopy
entries.description: (stream, dst): reads 1 byte through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18). TSBitmapPart's read takes its two offset bytes with it.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_NodeCtor
entries.description: (node): maybe_Point3S_Ctor on the node's leading normal. The element constructor TSBSPPart_ReadFromStream hands Rtl_VectorNew for the 14-byte nodes.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_Dtor
entries.description: TSCellAnimPart vtable 0047f12c slot +0x18 (part, flags): decrements *005ddec0, TSPartList_Dtor(part, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set. Ghidra had no function here.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_Dtor
entries.description: TSBitmapPart vtable 0047f160 slot +0x18 (part, flags): when part is set, decrements *005ddec0 twice (its own level and TSPartBase's), TSBase_Dtor(part, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSShape_Ctor
entries.description: TSShape constructor (vtable 0047f1c1, RTTI 'TSShape', 0x2a bytes): TSPartList_Ctor, its own vtable, and clears the transform array +0x18, the per-sequence frame array +0x1c and the sequence-length array +0x20. TSShape_Construct and ANShape_Construct run it. DBSIM's is TSShape_Ctor (00490928).

entries.name: TSShape_Dtor
entries.description: TSShape vtable 0047f1c1 slot +0x18 (shape, flags): decrements *005ddec0, restores the vtable, frees +0x20, +0x1c and +0x18, TSPartList_Dtor(shape, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSShape_Render
entries.description: TSShape vtable 0047f1c1 slot +0x1c (shape): binds the shape's own per-sequence frames (+0x1c, ShapeRender_BindCellFrames) and transform array (+0x18, ShapeRender_BindNodeTransforms); when 0047f188 is set, TSBounds_ScreenVisibility culls (0) or, for 2 while the context's +0x208 is 1, clears +0x208 around the draw; then swaps g_ActiveBitmapArray for the shape's bound DBA (TSShape_GetBoundBitmapArray, +0x26), draws the children with TSPartList_Render and restores the global. The class is TSShape by the vtable's RTTI; see docs/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: TSShapeInstance_Ctor
entries.description: TSShapeInstance constructor (vtable 0047f195, RTTI 'TSShapeInstance', 0xc bytes, over TSBase and ClassItem): (inst, shape) stores the shape at +4 and, when the shape's sequence count +0x24 is non-zero, an arena copy of its per-sequence frame array +0x1c at +8, else 0. DBSIM's is TSShapeInstance_Ctor (00490a58). ANShapeInstance_Ctor runs it.

entries.name: TSShapeInstance_Dtor
entries.description: TSShapeInstance vtable 0047f195 slot +0x18 (inst, flags): decrements *005ddec0, restores the vtable, frees the frame copy +8, TSBase_Dtor(inst, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: TSShapeInstance_Render
entries.description: TSShapeInstance vtable 0047f195 slot +0x1c (inst): TSShape_Render's body applied to the instance's shape (+4), except that the cell frames bound are the instance's own copy (+8) rather than the shape's. ANShapeInstance_Render calls it after installing its own transforms on the shape.

entries.name: Gfx_GetCurrentContext
entries.description: Returns the current drawing context at 0048e184 (set by Gfx_SetCurrentContext). Font_DrawGlyph, Font_DrawString and the shape renderers draw through it.

entries.name: ShapeRender_BindCellFrames
entries.description: (shape, cellFrames): stores cellFrames at 004869d4, which TSCellAnimPart_Render indexes by a part's sequence (+0x16), modulo its cell count, to pick the cell it draws; the first argument is not read. TSShape_Render passes the shape's own per-sequence frames (+0x1c), TSShapeInstance_Render the instance's copy (+8).

entries.name: TSBase_GetActiveBitmapArray
entries.description: return g_ActiveBitmapArray (DAT_005d8010). Paired with TSBase_SetActiveBitmapArray as the only two accessors of that global (confirmed via full xref list). See docs/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: TSShape_GetBoundBitmapArray
entries.description: (shape): returns the DBA bound to the shape at +0x26. A TSShape field (the object is 0x2a bytes; a TSShapeInstance is 0xc), set at run time rather than stored in the .DTS. See docs/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: TSBase_SetActiveBitmapArray
entries.description: g_ActiveBitmapArray = param_1. The only write site for DAT_005d8010 in the whole binary (confirmed via ES2FindAddressRefs on the global's address). See docs/formats/dts-texture-binding.md.

entries.name: TSShape_Construct
entries.description: The load function g_TSObjectTypeRegistry registers for tag 0x140008 'TSShape': 0x2a bytes from the arena, TSShape_Ctor, then the object's vtable +0xc read. Ghidra had no function here.

entries.name: TSShape_GetClassTag
entries.description: TSShape slot 0: returns 0x140008, TSShape_Construct's tag.

entries.name: TSShape_GetStreamSize
entries.description: TSShape slot +4: TSPartList_GetStreamSize, plus (when that is non-zero) 4 for the two counts, 2 per sequence (+0x24) and 0x20 per transform (+0x16).

entries.name: TSShape_GetMemorySize
entries.description: TSShape slot +8: 0x2a + 4 per child + 0x20 per transform + 4 per sequence, plus each child's GetMemorySize.

entries.name: TSShape_ReadFromStream
entries.description: TSShape vtable 0047f1c1 slot +0xc (shape, stream): TSPartList_ReadFromStream, then the transform count +0x16 and sequence count +0x24; arena arrays for the sequence lengths +0x20 and the per-sequence current frames +0x1c (2 bytes per sequence) and +0x16 32-byte Transforms at +0x18 (Rtl_VectorNew with Transform_Ctor); reads the lengths (Stream_ReadWords) and the transforms, and zeroes the frames. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's TSShape_ReadFromStream (00490d5c).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile of 00462a84; es2_naming.py diff VSHELL 00462a84 DBSIM 00490d5c

entries.name: TSShape_WriteToStream
entries.description: TSShape slot +0x10 (shape, stream): TSPartList_WriteToStream, the two counts, the sequence lengths +0x20 (Stream_WriteWords) and the transforms +0x18.

entries.name: TSShape_DebugPrint
entries.description: TSShape slot +0x14 (shape, verbose, indent): VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, then when verbose 'transformListSize %3d' (+0x16), 'seqListSize %3d' (+0x24), 'seqLenList' with each length of +0x20, and TSPartList_DebugPrint with verbose - 1 and indent + 1.

entries.name: Stream_WriteWords
entries.description: (stream, count, buffer): writes count * 2 bytes through the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14).

entries.name: Stream_ReadWords
entries.description: (stream, count, dst): reads count * 2 bytes through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18).

entries.name: Stream_ReadWord2
entries.description: (stream, dst): reads 2 bytes through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18); a second copy of Stream_ReadWord with an identical body, in the block after Stream_WriteWords and Stream_ReadWords. It sits where DBSIM's Stream_ReadWord (00491080) does in that binary's layout.

entries.name: Stream_WriteWord2
entries.description: (stream, value): writes the low 2 bytes of its value argument (LEA of [EBP+0xc]) through the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14); a second copy of Stream_WriteWord with an identical body, beside Stream_ReadWord2. Ghidra shows it with one parameter, so the decompile drops the value at every call site.

entries.name: Transform_LocalPointDotNormal
entries.description: (point, transform, normal): subtracts the transform's int32 translation from the point, rotates the difference by the transform's Q14 matrix and returns its dot product with the int16 normal as a 64-bit value. TSBSPPart_RenderNode calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's Transform_LocalPointDotNormal (004910b4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00462dd8; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004910b4

entries.name: Poly_ProjectShapeVerticesPerspective
entries.description: Poly_ProjectShapeVertices' perspective path: for each vertex of the current polygon not yet seen, transforms it by g_ModelToView (004521dc); when its depth is beyond 005d7fd8 projects it as (x << 005d7fd4) / depth + 005d7fe0 and 005d7fe4 - (z << 005d7fd4) / depth into the screen list 005ddaae and the cache 005dbb6e and marks it 2, else marks it 1. A cached vertex (2) is copied. Returns 1 when any vertex is marked 1, else 0; 0 at once when the polygon is empty or the shift is 0.

entries.name: ANSequence_NextFrame
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x20 (sequence, frame): frame + 1 while frame is below the frame count +0xa less 1, else frame unchanged: the last frame holds. ANCyclicSequence overrides the slot with ANCyclicSequence_NextFrame. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANSequence_NextFrame (00478654). Ghidra had no function here.

entries.name: ANSequence_PrevFrame
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x24 (sequence, frame): frame - 1, or frame (0) at the first frame: it holds rather than wrapping. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANSequence_PrevFrame (00478670).

entries.name: ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x28, (seq, frame, target, flag): 1 when frame < target, or frame == target and flag is 0; otherwise 0. AnimThread_FindTransition asks it of a transition's destination sequence for forward play, through ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetDir, with the thread's +0x1c as the flag. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget (00478680).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046301c and 00465836; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00478680

entries.name: ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x2c, ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget's mirror for backward play: 1 when frame > target, or frame == target and flag is 0. ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetDir calls it when the thread plays backward. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward (004786ac).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463048 and 00465836; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004786ac

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_NextFrame
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x20 (sequence, frame): frame + 1 while frame is below the frame count +0xa less 1, else 0: it wraps. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_NextFrame (004786d8).

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_PrevFrame
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x24 (sequence, frame): frame - 1, or the frame count +0xa less 1 at frame 0: it wraps. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_PrevFrame (004786f8).

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTarget_Always
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x28: returns 1 whatever its arguments, where ANSequence_FrameShortOfTarget compares them. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTarget_Always (00478714).

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward_Always
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x2c: returns 1 whatever its arguments, where ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward compares them. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ANCyclicSequence_FrameShortOfTargetBackward_Always (00478720).

entries.name: ANShapeInstance_Ctor
entries.description: ANShapeInstance constructor (vtable 0047f420, RTTI 'ANShapeInstance', 0x42 bytes): (inst, shape) TSShapeInstance_Ctor, its own vtable, ten cleared dwords at +0x1a; then from the shape's animation list (+0x2a): the default-transform count (+0x16) into +0xc, a byte array of that many flags at +0xe (all set to 1), 12-byte entries at +0x12 copied from the list's transforms (+0x12) by each default transform index (+0x18), and that many 32-byte Transforms at +0x16 (Transform_Ctor); then 004634a4(inst) and 00465778(+0x16).

entries.name: ANShapeInstance_Dtor
entries.description: ANShapeInstance vtable 0047f420 slot +0x18 (inst, flags): decrements *005ddec0, restores the vtable, frees +0xe, +0x12 and +0x16, TSShapeInstance_Dtor(inst, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: ShapeInst_CountThreads
entries.description: (shapeInst): returns how many of the ten thread slots from shapeInst+0x1a are filled, counting up to the first null. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_CountThreads (004788a4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463210; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004788a4

entries.name: ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority
entries.description: (shapeInst): bubble-sorts the filled thread slots at shapeInst+0x1a by AnimThread_SequencePriority. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority (004788c4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463230; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004788c4

entries.name: ShapeInst_RegisterThread
entries.description: (shapeInst, thread): stores thread in the first empty of the ten slots at shapeInst+0x1a and re-sorts them with ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority; returns 1, or 0 when all ten are taken. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_RegisterThread (00478930).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046329c; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00478930

entries.name: ShapeInst_RemoveThread
entries.description: (shapeInst, thread): finds thread in the ten slots at shapeInst+0x1a, shifts the slots after it down by one and zeroes the tenth; returns 1, or 0 when thread is not registered. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_RemoveThread (00478964).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 004632d0; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 00478964

entries.name: AnimThread_StepAll
entries.description: (shapeInst, dt): AnimThread_Advance on every thread, last slot first over ShapeInst_CountThreads slots, then ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority, then, when there is a first thread, AnimThread_ReadRootTransform of it into world slot 0 (shapeInst+0x16). ShapeInstance_StepAnimation calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_StepAll (004789a0).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046330c; compared with DBSIM 004789a0

entries.name: ShapeInst_EvalAllNodeLocals
entries.description: (shapeInst): AnimThread_EvalNodeLocals on every thread, last first, with the local-transform array (+0x12) and the dirty flags (+0xe). ShapeInstance_StepAnimation calls it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_EvalAllNodeLocals (004789f4).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 00463360; compared with DBSIM 004789f4

entries.name: ShapeInst_ReadRootTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, out): AnimThread_ReadRootTransform of the first thread into out (through AnimThread_ReadRootTransform_Thunk), or Transform_Reset(out) when the instance has none. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_ReadRootTransform (00478a30).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 0046339c; compared with DBSIM 00478a30

entries.name: ShapeInst_SeedRootTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, transform): when the instance has a thread, AnimThread_WriteRootTransform(first thread, transform) and copies the 0x20-byte transform into world slot 0 (shapeInst+0x16). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_SeedRootTransform (00478a70).
entries.source: VSHELL decompile at 004633c4; compared with DBSIM 00478a70

entries.name: ShapeInst_ComposeChildTransform

ShapeInst_BuildWorldTransforms calls it for a root node. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInst_ExpandRootTransform (00478b10).

entries.name: ShapeInstance_StepAnimation
entries.description: (shapeInst, dt): AnimThread_StepAll, ShapeInst_EvalAllNodeLocals, ShapeInst_BuildWorldTransforms. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's ShapeInstance_StepAnimation (00478c2c).

entries.name: ShapeInst_PushModelTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, scratch, root): saves Raster_GetModelTransform, concatenates root onto it into scratch, installs scratch with Raster_SetModelTransform and returns the saved pointer. ANShapeInstance_Render brackets TSShapeInstance_Render with it and ShapeInst_PopModelTransform. DBSIM's copy is 00478c54.

entries.name: ShapeInst_PopModelTransform
entries.description: (shapeInst, saved): Raster_SetModelTransform(saved) when saved is non-null, restoring what ShapeInst_PushModelTransform replaced. DBSIM's copy is 00478c84.

entries.name: ANShapeInstance_Render
entries.description: ANShapeInstance vtable 0047f420 slot +0x1c: builds a local Transform, 004635a4(inst, local, +0x16), installs the instance's transforms +0x16 as its shape's transform array (shape +0x18), TSShapeInstance_Render(inst), then 004635d0(inst, the 004635a4 result).

entries.name: ANShape_Render
entries.description: ANShape vtable 0047f684 slot +0x1c: does nothing. An animated shape is drawn through its ANShapeInstance (ANShapeInstance_Render), not by itself.

entries.name: TSShapeInstance_GetShape
entries.description: (inst): returns the shape at +4. ANShapeInstance_Ctor and ANShapeInstance_Render reach the ANShape through it.

entries.name: AnimThread_ReadRootTransform_Thunk
entries.description: (thread, out): AnimThread_ReadRootTransform(thread, out). ShapeInst_ReadRootTransform calls it.

entries.name: Raster_GetModelTransform
entries.description: Returns 005d7fa4, the model transform Raster_SetModelTransform installed. ShapeInst_PushModelTransform saves it.

entries.name: AN_RegisterClassItems
entries.description: Static initialiser: ClassItem_RegisterBucket(0047f750, [0047f780]), the AN class-item table (ANSequence, ANCyclicSequence, ANShape and the rest). The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AN_RegisterClassItems (004912d0).

entries.name: ANSequence_Construct
entries.description: The load function VSHELL's AN class-item table (0047f750) registers for tag 0x1e0001 'ANSequence': 0x1a bytes from the arena, the ClassItem, TSBase and ANSequence vtables (0047f720 last), then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANSequence_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot 0: returns 0x1e0001, ANSequence_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANSequence_GetStreamSize
entries.description: ANSequence slot +4: 10 + 6 per frame (+0xa) + 2 per part (+0x10) + 2 per frame per part. ANCyclicSequence inherits it.

entries.name: ANSequence_GetMemorySize
entries.description: ANSequence slot +8: the same sum with base 0x1a. ANCyclicSequence inherits it.

entries.name: ANSequence_ReadFromStream
entries.description: ANSequence slot +0xc (sequence, stream): the tick +4, priority +6, GM +8 and frame count +0xa; the frame count's 6-byte frames into an arena array at +0xc; the part count +0x10 and its int16 part list at +0x12; then a frames-by-parts int16 transform-index table at +0x16 (Stream_ReadWordsCopy). Names from ANSequence_DebugPrint's labels. ANCyclicSequence inherits it.

entries.name: ANSequence_WriteToStream
entries.description: ANSequence slot +0x10 (sequence, stream): writes what ANSequence_ReadFromStream reads, in the same order.

entries.name: ANSequence_DebugPrint
entries.description: ANSequence slot +0x14 (sequence, verbose, indent): VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, then when verbose 'tick %3d priority %d GM %d' (+4, +6, +8), the frames (words 0, 2 and 1 of each 6-byte entry under 'tick, 1st transition, transition...'), the 'Part List' and the 'Transform Index List' part by part.

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_Construct
entries.description: The load function the AN class-item table registers for tag 0x1e0004 'ANCyclicSequence': 0x1a bytes from the arena, the vtable chain through ANSequence to ANCyclicSequence's 0047f6e4, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANCyclicSequence_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot 0: returns 0x1e0004, ANCyclicSequence_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANAnimList_Construct
entries.description: The load function the AN class-item table registers for tag 0x1e0002 'ANAnimList': 0x22 bytes from the arena, the ClassItem, TSBase and ANAnimList vtables (0047f6b8 last), then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANAnimList_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANAnimList vtable 0047f6b8 slot 0: returns 0x1e0002, ANAnimList_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANAnimList_GetStreamSize
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +4: 10 for the five counts + 8 per transition (+0x1c) + 12 per transform (+0x10) + 2 per default transform (+0x16) + 4 per relation (+0xa), plus ClassItem_ItemTotalSize of each sequence (+4 of them at +6).

entries.name: ANAnimList_GetMemorySize
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +8: the same sum with base 0x22, plus each sequence's GetMemorySize.

entries.name: ANAnimList_ReadFromStream
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +0xc (list, stream): the sequence count +4 and that many sequences loaded with VshellClassItem_LoadItem into an arena array at +6; the transition count +0x1c and its 8-byte entries at +0x1e; the transform count +0x10 and its 12-byte entries at +0x12; the default-transform count +0x16 and its int16 indexes at +0x18; the relation count +0xa and its 4-byte entries at +0xc. Names from ANAnimList_DebugPrint's labels.

entries.name: ANAnimList_WriteToStream
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +0x10 (list, stream): writes what ANAnimList_ReadFromStream reads, the sequences through ClassItem_StoreItem.

entries.name: ANAnimList_DebugPrint
entries.description: ANAnimList slot +0x14 (list, verbose, indent): VshellClassItem_DebugPrintType, then when verbose 'Sequence Count %d' and each sequence's DebugPrint; 'Transitions (tick, destSequence, ...)' four int16s per entry; 'Transforms (rx ry rz tx ty tz)'; 'Default Transforms'; 'Relations (parent, destination)'.

entries.name: ANShape_Construct
entries.description: The load function the AN class-item table registers for tag 0x1e0003 'ANShape': 0x2e bytes from the arena, TSShape_Ctor, ANShape's vtable 0047f684, then the object's vtable +0xc read.

entries.name: ANShape_GetClassTag
entries.description: ANShape vtable 0047f684 slot 0: returns 0x1e0003, ANShape_Construct's tag.

entries.name: ANShape_GetStreamSize
entries.description: ANShape slot +4: TSShape_GetStreamSize plus ClassItem_ItemTotalSize of the animation list at +0x2a.

entries.name: ANShape_GetMemorySize
entries.description: ANShape slot +8: the animation list's GetMemorySize + TSShape_GetMemorySize + 4.

entries.name: ANShape_ReadFromStream
entries.description: ANShape slot +0xc (shape, stream): TSShape_ReadFromStream, then one more class item, the shape's ANAnimList, into +0x2a (VshellClassItem_LoadItem(stream, 0)).

entries.name: ANShape_WriteToStream
entries.description: ANShape slot +0x10 (shape, stream): TSShape_WriteToStream, then ClassItem_StoreItem(+0x2a, stream, 0).

entries.name: ANShape_DebugPrint
entries.description: ANShape slot +0x14 (shape, verbose, indent): TSShape_DebugPrint, then when verbose the animation list's own DebugPrint with verbose - 1 and indent + 1.

entries.name: TSPartBase_Dtor

entries.name: Stream_ReadWord
entries.description: (stream, dst): reads 2 bytes through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18). GLFont_ReadFromStream reads its int16 fields with it.

entries.name: Stream_WriteWord

entries.name: Stream_ReadWordsCopy
entries.description: (stream, count, dst): reads count * 2 bytes through the stream's read slot (vtable +0x18); a second copy of Stream_ReadWords. TSBSPPart's, TSDetailPart's and ANSequence's reads call it.

entries.description: (stream, count, src): writes count * 2 bytes through the stream's write slot (vtable +0x14); a second copy of Stream_WriteWords.

entries.name: ANShape_Dtor

entries.description: ANCyclicSequence vtable 0047f6e4 slot +0x18 (sequence, flags): when set, decrements *005ddec0 twice (its own level and ANSequence's), TSBase_Dtor(sequence, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.description: ANSequence vtable 0047f720 slot +0x18 (sequence, flags): when set, decrements *005ddec0, TSBase_Dtor(sequence, 0), then Mem_Delete when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: AnimThread_SequencePriority
entries.description: (thread): returns the int16 at +6 of the sequence the thread is playing (shape->sequences[thread+4]), the sequence's priority. ShapeInst_SortThreadsByPriority orders by it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_SequencePriority (00478d80).

entries.name: AnimThread_ElapsedTicks
entries.description: (thread): the ticks played into the current sequence: the durations (+0 of each 6-byte frame record) of the frames from 0, stepping with the sequence's vtable +0x20, up to the current frame (+6), plus the intra-frame offset +0x1c.

entries.name: AnimThread_LoadFrameGroundMovement
entries.description: (thread, sequence, frame): when the sequence's ground-movement flag (+8) is set, AnimThread_LoadGroundTransform with the root node's transform index for the frame (+0x16 indices, frame * +0x10 parts); otherwise clears thread+0x20. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_LoadFrameGroundMovement (00478de8), which inlines the load.

entries.description: (thread): when thread+0x20 is set, folds the frame's ground transform (translation +0x22, rotation +0x28) into the stored transform at +0x2e. AnimThread_Advance runs it on each frame passed forward. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_CommitGroundMovement (00478e60).

entries.description: (thread, out): the stored transform (+0x2e) when there is no ground movement (+0x20 clear), otherwise the ground transform scaled by +0x1c / +0x1e (the fraction of the frame played) concatenated onto it. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_ReadRootTransform (00478fa8).

entries.description: (thread, sequence, frame, offset): cuts a thread straight to a sequence and frame: sequence at +4 and +8, frame at +6, the sequence's vtable +0x20 answer at +0xa, offset at +0x1c, the frame's duration at +0x1e, AnimThread_LoadFrameGroundMovement; then clears the target (+0x16 and +0x18 = -1, +0x1a = 0), sets +0xc = -1 and stores 1 (at target) in the flags at +0x50. entries.description: (thread, sequence, position): sums the sequence's frame durations, scales the Q14 position by total - 1 (FixedMulQ14_Thunk), walks the frames subtracting durations and AnimThread_SetSequence's the frame and remainder. entries.name: AnimThread_FindTransition
entries.description: (thread): walks the current sequence's frames from the current frame (+6) when playing backward (rate +0x4e < 0) or the next frame (+0xa) otherwise, stepping with the sequence's vtable +0x24 or +0x20 until it laps, and takes the first transition (AnimThread_FrameTransitionFirst/Count) into the target sequence +0x16 that ANSequence_FrameShortOfTargetDir accepts, storing its fields at +0xe..+0x14 with the frame it leaves in +0xc; +0xc = -1 when none does. The VSHELL copy of DBSIM's AnimThread_FindTransition (004792c8), with the transition-table reads and the direction test out of line.

entries.description: (thread, sequence, frame, flags): stores the target at +0x16/+0x18/+0x1a and clears the at-target bit (+0x50 bit 0); runs AnimThread_FindTransition unless the target is -1 or is already the current sequence and frame with no offset, in which case it sets the bit and +0xc = -1.
